name: UltraAddons for Elementor
author: Saiful Islam

sections.description:
UltraAddons for Elementor is a feature-rich addon library for the Elementor Page Builder. It provides unique widgets, ready-made templates, and powerful tools to build complete websites easily using drag & drop — no coding required.

Create stunning pages in just a few clicks. UltraAddons works with any WordPress theme and plugin, offering advanced customization, flexible display conditions, and useful extensions.

⭐ Features

  • 85+ Full Page Templates
  • 500+ Ready-to-use Blocks
  • Add Custom Fonts (Free)
  • Logical Widget Conditions (Show/Hide widgets by condition)
  • Custom Header for any page or entire site
  • Custom Topbar for announcements or offers
  • Custom Footer for any page or entire site
  • Display Elementor Page / Section / Template anywhere using shortcode (example: [UltraAddons_Template id='123'])
  • Many ready widgets
  • Woo Product Table with design, typography and styling controls
  • Wrapper Link for section/column/widget
  • Hover animation for any section/column/widget
  • Advanced Heading with color & typography controls
  • Advanced Button with color & typography controls
  • Advanced Slider with dynamic content and pre-built templates

🚀 500+ READY BLOCKS AND 85+ READY PAGES

Use our pre-made sections and templates to create your site quickly and professionally.

📌 Demo (selected)

  • Advance Heading — Advance Heading widget
  • Button — Powerful button widget
  • Counter — Animated counter widget
  • Count Down Timer — Countdown timer
  • Step Flow — Info box for services or process steps
  • Hotspot — Product hotspots
  • Icon Box — Icon with text box
  • Testimonial Box — Beautiful testimonial display
  • Team Box — Team member display
  • Card — Profile or product card
  • Skill Chart — Display skills/statistics
  • Post Timeline — Timeline post view
  • Work Hour — Display working hours or official hours
  • News Ticker — Display notices or news
  • Moving Letters — 15 animation styles for text
  • Dual Color Heading — Attractive dual-color headings
  • Timeline — Company or personal timeline
  • Accordion — FAQ or information accordion
  • Animated Headline — Animated heading styles

👉 View All Demos: https://ultraaddons.com/widgets/

🛒 WooCommerce

  • Product Categories
  • Product Grid
  • Product Table
  • WooCommerce Products widget
  • Products Carousel
  • Products Flip

📝 Forms

  • Contact Form 7 integration
  • WPForms integration
  • Formidable Forms integration
  • Caldera Forms integration

📊 Charts

  • Bar Chart
  • Line Chart
  • Pie Chart
  • Polar Chart
  • Doughnut Chart
  • Mixed Chart
  • Radar Chart

✨ Extensions

  • Wrapper Link — link any element.
  • Hover Effect — add hover effects to elements.
  • CSS Transform (Pro) — advanced transforms (Pro).
  • Animation Effect (Pro) — advanced animations (Pro).
  • Background Overlay — overlay effects.
  • Ultra Effect (Pro) — advanced visual effects (Pro).
  • Gradient Text — gradient color effects on text.

Header & Footer Builder

To replace or add to your theme’s default header/footer using Elementor templates:

Step 1: Create an Elementor template: Dashboard → Elementor Template → Add New (create as Page template).
Step 2: Go to Dashboard → UltraAddons → Header Footer and choose your template for header/footer.

Shortcode: [UltraAddons_Template id='template_id']

Use this shortcode to display any Elementor page/section/template anywhere (widgets, posts, Gutenberg blocks). Example: [UltraAddons_Template id='123'] — here 123 is the POST_ID of the Elementor template.

🥇 CONTRIBUTE
You are welcome to contribute to this project. Fork the repository on GitHub.

* jQuery.Appear.js — https://github.com/morr/jquery.appear
* jQuery.barfiller.js — https://github.com/9bitStudios/barfiller
sections.installation:
1. Upload ultraaddons-elementor-lite to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support any theme?

Yes.

Can I use this plugin for my theme?

Yes.

Does it support customization using hooks?

Yes. Many filters and action hooks are available for customization.
